repository_read_contract.explicit_exclusion: Existing rhythms.json bass_levels are not a source for any riff timing, note choice, phrase or contour in this catalogue.

design_contract.timing_rule: All riff timing is self-contained in integer PPQ ticks; do not substitute or quantize to rhythms.json bass_levels.
design_contract.eligibility_rule: A riff is selectable only when both the current rhythm ID and current chord suffix occur in its compatibility lists.
design_contract.scale_rule: compatible_scales lists the defined C-normalized scale vocabularies that contain the riff's stable pitch-class material; explicitly marked chromatic approach notes may fall outside those scales.
design_contract.copyright_rule: No copyrighted commercial bass line is transcribed note-for-note. External material is used for genre/theory concepts; generated riffs are original theory-derived patterns.
